name: Nether Bolt
description: Fires a bolt of nether; the undead shrug it off.

name: Sense Invisible
description: Lets you see invisible monsters for 24+1d24 turns.

name: Create Darkness
description: Darkens the area around you, and the room you are in.

name: Bat Form
description: Changes you into a bat: weak, but with excellent senses. A bat cannot use items.

name: Read Minds
description: Detects monsters with minds nearby, and maps the area around each of them.

name: Tap Unlife
description: Drains the nearest undead monster, turning the damage into mana.

name: Crush
description: Kills every monster in view with fewer than four times your level in hit points, at some cost to you.

name: Sleep Evil
description: Puts every evil monster in view to sleep.

name: Shadow Shift
description: Displaces your spirit a short distance, hurting your body as it is dragged along.

name: Disenchant
description: Fires a bolt of disenchantment.

name: Frighten
description: Scares a monster, unless it is fearless.

name: Vampire Strike
description: Leaps to the nearest living monster and drains its blood, healing and feeding you.

name: Dispel Life
description: Damages every living monster in view.

name: Dark Spear
description: Fires a beam of darkness.

name: Warg Form
description: Changes you into a warg, with berserk strength.

name: Banish Spirits
description: Teleports away every monster with a spirit in view.

name: Annihilate
description: Drains four times your level in hit points from a living monster.

name: Grond's Blow
description: Destroys everything within 15 squares of you.

name: Unleash Chaos
effect: random:3; beam:chaos:8d{L}; ball:chaos:8d{L}:1; ball:chaos:8d{L}:3; aggravate; project_los:scare:{L}
description: Fires chaos as a beam or a ball, waking everything nearby and frightening whatever is in view.

name: Fume of Mordor
description: Darkens and maps the whole level, and senses every object on it.

name: Storm of Darkness
description: Invokes a great ball of darkness.

name: Seek Battle
description: Detects nearby monsters that can be frightened.

name: Berserk Strength
description: Removes fear and sends you into a berserk rage.

name: Whirlwind Attack
description: Strikes every adjacent enemy: one blow at level 5, one more every 15 levels.

name: Shatter Stone
description: Destroys an adjacent section of wall or rubble.

name: Leap into Battle
description: Runs up to 4 squares at a monster and strikes it; each square run costs a quarter of the blows.

name: Grim Purpose
description: Makes your mind too focused to be slowed, paralyzed or confused.

name: Maim Foe
description: Strikes an adjacent enemy with one blow per 15 levels, stunning it if any lands.

name: Howl of the Damned
description: Tries to frighten every monster in view.

name: Venom
description: Coats your weapon with poison.

name: Werewolf Form
description: With a blood-curdling cry you become half man, half wolf.

name: Unholy Reprieve
description: Restores strength, intelligence, constitution and experience, at the cost of 66 hit points.

name: Forceful Blow
description: A single mighty blow that hurls the target back and may stun it.

name: Quake
description: Causes a great earthquake around you.

name: Relentless Taunting
description: Makes monsters keen to close in on you, and half as likely to use spells or other ranged attacks.

name: Bloodlust
description: A powerful desire to kill, fed by every kill: extra damage and blows, but it wears on body and mind.

name: Power Sacrifice
description: Exchanges 50 hit points for 50 mana.

name: Zone of Unmagic
description: A zone of disenchantment around you, radius 4, affecting you as well as the monsters in it.

name: Vampire Form
description: Takes the form of a vampire at the cost of a quarter of your hit points, then leaps to feed on the nearest living monster.

name: Curse
description: Deals direct damage to a monster, more the more hurt it already is, at the cost of 100 hit points.

name: Command
description: Takes control of a monster: for a while you move it instead of yourself.

name: Magic Missile
description: Fires a bolt of pure magic — sometimes a beam — with more dice as you gain levels.

name: Light Room
description: Lights up the room you are in and the squares around you.

name: Find Traps, Doors & Stairs
description: Detects the traps, doors and stairs nearby.

name: Phase Door
description: Teleports you up to 10 squares away.

name: Electric Arc
description: A short beam of lightning, longer as you gain levels.

name: Detect Monsters
description: Detects the visible monsters nearby.

name: Fire Ball
description: A ball of fire, radius 2.

name: Object Detection
description: Detects the objects nearby, gold included.

name: Detect Stairs
description: Detects the stairs (and doors) in a wide area.

name: Recharging
description: Adds charges to a wand or staff; a failed attempt destroys it.

name: Reveal Monsters
description: Detects all the monsters nearby.

name: Recharging
description: Adds charges to a wand or staff; a failed attempt destroys it.

name: Identify Rune
description: Reveals an unknown rune on something you carry.

name: Treasure Detection
description: Detects gold and senses objects nearby.

name: Frost Bolt
description: A bolt (sometimes a beam) of frost.

name: Reveal Monsters
description: Detects all the monsters nearby.

name: Acid Spray
description: A spray of acid in a cone, up to 10 squares.

name: Disable Traps, Destroy Doors
description: Destroys the doors and traps next to you.

name: Teleport Self
description: Teleports you a level-dependent distance.

name: Teleport Other
description: Teleports away the first monster in the bolt's path.

name: Resistance
description: Temporary resistance to acid, lightning, frost and fire.

name: Tap Magical Energy
description: Drains the charges of a wand or staff into mana, leaving you a little stunned.

name: Mana Channel
description: For a few turns your spells take three quarters of a turn.

name: Door Creation
description: Creates doors in the open squares around you.

name: Mana Bolt
description: A bolt (sometimes a beam) of pure mana.

name: Teleport Level
description: Takes you one level up or down.

name: Detection
description: Detects traps, doors, stairs, objects and monsters nearby.

name: Dimension Door
description: Teleports you to the targeted place.

name: Thrust Away
description: A short beam of force.

name: Teleport Self
description: Teleports you a level-dependent distance.

name: Teleport Other
description: Teleports away the first monster in the bolt's path.

name: Shock Wave
description: A ball of sound, radius 2.

name: Explosion
description: A blast of shards and force.

name: Banishment
description: Banishes every monster of a kind you choose.

name: Mass Banishment
description: Banishes the monsters around you.

name: Mana Storm
description: A great ball of pure mana.

name: Call Light
description: Lights the area and hurts light-sensitive monsters.

name: Detect Evil
description: Detects the evil monsters nearby.

name: Minor Healing
description: Heals a level-dependent amount, and eases cuts and stunning.

name: Bless
description: +5 armour and +10 to-hit for a while.

name: Sense Invisible
description: Lets you see invisible monsters for 24+1d24 turns.

name: Heroism
description: Heals a little and removes fear; from level 20, grants heroism too.

name: Orb of Draining
description: A holy orb, doubly hurtful to evil.

name: Spear of Light
description: A beam of light that hurts light-sensitive monsters.

name: Dispel Undead
description: Damages every undead monster in view.

name: Dispel Evil
description: Damages every evil monster in view.

name: Protection from Evil
description: Evil monsters' blows may be repelled, unless they are of a higher level than you.

name: Remove Curse
description: Tries to remove a curse.

name: Portal
description: Teleports you a medium distance.

name: Remembrance
description: Restores your life levels.

name: Word of Recall
description: Takes you to the town, or back to your deepest level, after a short delay.

name: Healing
description: Heals 2000 hit points and cures cuts, poison and stunning.

name: Restoration
description: Restores your stats.

name: Clairvoyance
description: Lights up, maps out and senses the objects of the whole level.

name: Protection from Evil
description: Evil monsters' blows may be repelled, unless they are of a higher level than you.

name: Remove Curse
description: Tries to remove a curse.

name: Enchant Weapon
description: Attempts to improve your weapon's accuracy and damage.

name: Enchant Armour
description: Attempts to improve a piece of your armour.

name: Smite Evil
description: Your blows slay evil creatures for a while.

name: Glyph of Warding
description: Inscribes a glyph that monsters must break to reach you.

name: Demon Bane
description: Your blows powerfully slay demons for a while.

name: Single Combat
description: Seals you and the target in a stone cell from which only the winner emerges.

name: Banish Evil
description: Teleports away every evil monster in view.

name: Word of Destruction
description: Destroys everything within 15 squares of you.

name: Holy Word
effect: dispel:EVIL:1d{L*4}; heal:1000; cure:afraid; cure:poisoned; cure:stun; cure:cut
description: Damages every evil monster in view, and heals and cures you.

name: Spear of Oromë
description: A beam of holy power.

name: Light of Manwë
description: A great ball of light.

name: Detect Life
description: Detects the living monsters nearby.

name: Fox Form
description: Changes you into a fox: fast and stealthy, but you can't use items.

name: Remove Hunger
description: Leaves you comfortably fed (but not satiated).

name: Stinking Cloud
description: A cloud of poison, radius 2.

name: Confuse Monster
description: Confuses a monster.

name: Slow Monster
description: Slows a monster.

name: Herbal Curing
description: Cures cuts, poison and stunning.

name: Resist Poison
description: Resistance to poison for 20+1d20 turns.

name: Turn Stone to Mud
description: Turns a wall to mud.

name: Sense Surroundings
description: Maps the area around you.

name: Cure Poison
description: Cures poison.

name: Resist Poison
description: Resistance to poison for 20+1d20 turns.

name: Turn Stone to Mud
description: Turns a wall to mud.

name: Sense Surroundings
description: Maps the area around you.

name: Lightning Strike
description: Lightning strikes the target, with a clap of thunder.

name: Earth Rising
description: A short beam of rising earth.

name: Trance
description: Holds the monsters next to you still.

name: Mass Sleep
description: Puts every monster in view to sleep.

name: Become Pukel-man
description: Changes you into a Púkel-man of stone.

name: Eagle's Flight
description: Changes you into an eagle.

name: Bear Form
description: Changes you into a bear.

name: Tremor
description: Shakes the ground around the target.

name: Haste Self
description: Hastes you (+10 speed) for a level-dependent time.

name: Revitalize
effect: restore_stat:str; restore_stat:int; restore_stat:wis; restore_stat:dex; restore_stat:con; restore_exp
description: Restores your stats and life levels.

name: Rapid Regeneration
description: Heals 30 hit points a turn for a few turns.

name: Herbal Curing
description: Cures cuts, poison and stunning, and feeds you.

name: Cover Tracks
description: You leave no scent, and monsters beyond a short way can't see you.

name: Create Arrows
description: Turns a staff into arrows, better from a deeper staff.

name: Decoy
description: Leaves a decoy that monsters who see it go for instead of you.

name: Brand Ammunition
description: Brands your ammunition with fire, frost or venom.

name: Meteor Swarm
description: Several meteors strike the target.

name: Rift
description: A beam of gravity.

name: Ice Storm
description: Ice lashes every monster in view.

name: Volcanic Eruption
description: Fire all around you, and the earth shakes.

name: River of Lightning
description: A great arc of plasma.

name: Hit and Run
description: Prepares you to vanish a short distance after your next attempt to steal.
